title: Kelajak rejalari va niyatlar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida going to, will va hozirgi davomli shakl yordamida kelajak rejalari, shu zahotdagi qarorlar va taxminlar haqida gapirasiz, vaqt iboralarini to‘g‘ri qo‘llaysiz hamda boshqalardan rejalari haqida kamida to‘rtta turli savol bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Kelajak haqida gapiramiz
scenes.say: Hello again! Last time we talked about the past. Today we look at the future: plans, decisions and predictions.
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yana uchrashganimdan xursandman. Oldingi darsda o‘tgan dam olish haqida o‘tgan zamonda hikoya qildik: went, saw, visited kabi fe’llarni ishlatdik. Bugun esa nigohimizni oldinga qaratamiz. Kelajak rejalari, niyatlar va taxminlar haqida gapirishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! O‘tgan safar o‘tmish haqida gaplashdik. Bugun kelajakka qaraymiz: rejalar, qarorlar va taxminlar.

scenes.title: Kelajakning uchta yo‘li
board: will + verb — decision now / prediction (qaror / taxmin)
scenes.say: I'm going to visit my grandma. OK, I'll help you. I'm meeting Tom tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida kelajak haqida ko‘pincha bitta shakl bilan gapiramiz: “boraman”, “qilaman”. Yana “bormoqchiman” degan niyat shakli ham bor. Ingliz tilida esa kelajak uchun bir nechta yo‘l bor va ularning har biri o‘z vazifasiga ega. Bugun asosan ikkitasini chuqur o‘rganamiz: “going to” va “will”.
scenes.say_uz: Buvimnikiga bormoqchiman. Mayli, sizga yordam beraman. Ertaga Tom bilan uchrashaman.

scenes.title: going to: tuzilishi
board: he / she / it is going to + verb
you / we / they are going to + verb

examples.t: I'm going to learn to drive.
We're going to buy a new car.

scenes.say: I'm going to study. She's going to cook dinner. They're going to travel.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi shakl: “going to”. Uning tuzilishi oddiy: avval “am”, “is” yoki “are”, keyin “going to”, keyin fe’lning birinchi, ya’ni lug‘at shakli. Masalan: “I am going to study” — men o‘qimoqchiman. Og‘zaki nutqda deyarli doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi: “I’m going to”, “she’s going to”, “we’re going to”.
scenes.say_uz: Men o‘qimoqchiman. U kechki ovqat pishirmoqchi. Ular sayohat qilmoqchi.

scenes.title: going to: ko‘proq misollar
board: He’s going to start a new job.
We’re going to paint the kitchen.
My sister is going to get married.
scenes.say: He's going to start a new job. We're going to paint the kitchen. My sister is going to get married in June.
scenes.say_native: Keling, hayotiy misollarni eshitamiz. “He’s going to start a new job” — u yangi ishni boshlamoqchi. “We’re going to paint the kitchen” — biz oshxonani bo‘yamoqchimiz. “My sister is going to get married” — singlim turmushga chiqmoqchi. Bu gaplarning barchasida bir umumiy narsa bor: qaror allaqachon qabul qilingan, odam bu haqida oldindan o‘ylagan.
scenes.say_uz: U yangi ishni boshlamoqchi. Biz oshxonani bo‘yamoqchimiz. Singlim iyunda turmushga chiqmoqchi.

scenes.title: going to: inkor shakli
scenes.say: I'm not going to buy it. He isn't going to come. We aren't going to wait.
scenes.say_native: Inkor gap tuzish uchun “am, is, are” dan keyin “not” qo‘yamiz: “I’m not going to buy it” — men uni sotib olmoqchi emasman. Qisqa shakllar: “isn’t” va “aren’t”. Masalan: “He isn’t going to come” — u kelmoqchi emas. “We aren’t going to wait” — biz kutib o‘tirmaymiz.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni sotib olmoqchi emasman. U kelmoqchi emas. Biz kutmaymiz.

scenes.title: going to va “-moqchi”
board: I’m going to call her. (Unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqchiman)
going to (future) ≠ going to the shop (motion)
scenes.say: I'm going to the shop. I'm going to call her. I'm going to go to the shop later.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “going to” ga eng yaqin shakl — “-moqchi”: bormoqchiman, o‘qimoqchiman. Rus tilini bilsangiz, “собираюсь” so‘ziga o‘xshaydi. Lekin bir muhim farq bor: “going” so‘zining asl ma’nosi “ketyapman”. “I’m going to the shop” — men do‘konga ketyapman, bu harakat. “I’m going to call her” esa — unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqchiman, bu niyat.
scenes.say_uz: Men do‘konga ketyapman. Unga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmoqchiman. Keyinroq do‘konga bormoqchiman.

scenes.title: going to dagi xatolar
board: ✓ I’m going to study. / She’s going to study.
scenes.say: Not: I going to study. Say: I'm going to study. Not: she is going to studies. Say: she's going to study.
scenes.say_native: Uchta keng tarqalgan xato. Birinchisi: “am, is, are” ni tushirib qoldirish: “I going to study”. O‘zbekchada “-man” qo‘shimchasi fe’lga yopishgani uchun inglizchada alohida so‘z kerakligi esdan chiqadi. Ikkinchisi: “to” dan keyingi fe’lni o‘zgartirish: “She is going to studies”. To‘g‘risi “study”, chunki “to” dan keyin doim lug‘at shakli.
scenes.say_uz: I going to study emas, I’m going to study deng. She is going to studies emas, she’s going to study deng.

scenes.title: Reja tuzing
scenes.say: Make sentences with going to.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi so‘zlardan “going to” bilan to‘liq gap tuzing. Birinchisi: men amakimnikiga bormoqchiman. Ikkinchisi inkor: Sara televizor ko‘rmoqchi emas. Uchinchisi: biz ziyofat qilmoqchimiz. To‘rtinchisi: Tom velosiped sotib olmoqchi. Qisqa shakllardan foydalaning va har bir gapni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say_uz: going to bilan gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I’m going to visit my uncle.
2) Sara isn’t going to watch TV.
3) We’re going to have a party.
4) Tom’s going to buy a bike.
scenes.say: I'm going to visit my uncle. Sara isn't going to watch TV. We're going to have a party. Tom's going to buy a bike.
scenes.say_native: Javoblarni tekshiring. Birinchi: “I’m going to visit my uncle.” Ikkinchi: “Sara isn’t going to watch TV.” Uchinchi: “We’re going to have a party.” To‘rtinchi: “Tom’s going to buy a bike.” Oxirgi gapda “Tom’s” — bu “Tom is” ning qisqa shakli, egalik emas. Agar siz “Tom is going to” desangiz ham to‘g‘ri, faqat sal rasmiyroq eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Amakimnikiga bormoqchiman. Sara televizor ko‘rmoqchi emas. Biz ziyofat qilmoqchimiz. Tom velosiped olmoqchi.

scenes.title: will: tuzilishi
board: I / you / he / she / we / they + will + verb
scenes.say: I'll help you. She'll be late. We won't forget.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi shakl: “will”. Uning tuzilishi “going to” dan ham oson, chunki “will” barcha shaxslar uchun bir xil: “I will”, “she will”, “they will”. Undan keyin fe’lning lug‘at shakli keladi: “I will help”, “she will help”. Og‘zaki nutqda “will” qisqarib “’ll” bo‘ladi: “I’ll”, “you’ll”, “she’ll”, “we’ll”.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga yordam beraman. U kechikadi. Biz unutmaymiz.

scenes.title: will: misollar
scenes.say: I'll carry your bag. You'll love this film. They won't be at home tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Endi “will” bilan bir nechta jonli misol. “I’ll carry your bag” — sumkangizni men ko‘taraman. “You’ll love this film” — bu film sizga juda yoqadi. “They won’t be at home” — ular uyda bo‘lishmaydi. E’tibor bering: “be” fe’li “will” dan keyin o‘zgarmaydi. “She will be”, “they will be” deymiz, “she will is” emas.
scenes.say_uz: Sumkangizni men ko‘taraman. Bu film sizga juda yoqadi. Ular ertaga uyda bo‘lishmaydi.

scenes.title: will dagi xatolar
board: ✗ She will calls you. / ✗ I will going.
✓ I’ll call you. / She’ll call you.
scenes.say: I won't go. I want to go. Won't. Want.
scenes.say_native: Diqqat qiling. Birinchi xato: “I will to call you”. “Will” dan keyin “to” qo‘yilmaydi. Ikkinchi xato: “She will calls you” — “will” dan keyin fe’lga “-s” qo‘shilmaydi. Uchinchisi: “will” va “going to” ni aralashtirib “I will going” deyish. Bu ikki xil shakl, ularni qo‘shib bo‘lmaydi. Va talaffuz xatosi: “won’t” va “want” ni adashtirish.
scenes.say_uz: Men bormayman. Men bormoqchiman. Won’t. Want.

scenes.title: will yoki won’t
scenes.say: Complete with will or won't.
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidagi fe’lni “will” yoki “won’t” bilan qo‘ying. Birinchi gapda kimdir sirini aytdi va siz va’da beryapsiz: hech kimga aytmayman. Ikkinchisida kech bo‘ldi va siz hozir qaror qilyapsiz. Uchinchisida u soat oltida shu yerda bo‘ladi. To‘rtinchisida esa inkor: ularga bu mehmonxona yoqmaydi. Gaplarni to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say_uz: will yoki won’t bilan to‘ldiring.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: I won't tell anyone. I'll take a taxi. She'll be here at six. They won't like this hotel.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — “Don’t worry, I won’t tell anyone.” Ikkinchi — “It’s late. I’ll take a taxi.” Uchinchi — “She’ll be here at six.” To‘rtinchi — “They won’t like this hotel.” Birinchi gapda “anyone” so‘ziga e’tibor bering: inkor gapda “hech kim” ma’nosida “anyone” ishlatiladi. Ikkinchi gapdagi “I’ll take a taxi” esa hozirgina qabul qilingan qaror.
scenes.say_uz: Hech kimga aytmayman. Taksi olaman. U soat oltida shu yerda bo‘ladi. Ularga bu mehmonxona yoqmaydi.

scenes.title: Reja yoki shu zahotdagi qaror
board: I’m going to buy milk. (oldindan rejalashtirgan)
Oh, no milk! I’ll buy some. (hozir qaror qildim)
scenes.say: I'm going to buy milk after work. Oh, there's no milk! I'll buy some.
scenes.say_native: Endi darsning eng muhim qismi. Qachon “going to”, qachon “will”? Agar qaror gapirishdan oldin qabul qilingan bo‘lsa, ya’ni bu reja bo‘lsa, “going to” ishlatamiz. Masalan, ertalab ro‘yxat tuzdingiz va aytasiz: “I’m going to buy milk.” Agar qaror aynan gapirayotgan paytda tug‘ilsa, “will” ishlatamiz. Muzlatgichni ochdingiz, sut yo‘q: “Oh, there’s no milk!
scenes.say_uz: Ishdan keyin sut olmoqchiman. Voy, sut yo‘q ekan! Men olib kelaman.

scenes.title: Shu zahotdagi qarorlar
board: The phone’s ringing. — I’ll get it!
I’m cold. — I’ll close the window.
Tea or coffee? — I’ll have tea, please.
scenes.say: The phone's ringing. I'll get it! Tea or coffee? I'll have tea, please.
scenes.say_native: Kundalik hayotda “will” bilan shu zahotda qaror qilishning misollari juda ko‘p. Telefon jiringladi: “I’ll get it!” — men olaman! Kimdir sovqotdi: “I’ll close the window” — derazani yopaman. Kafeda ofitsiant so‘radi, siz menyuga qarab hozir tanladingiz: “I’ll have tea, please” — choy olaman.
scenes.say_uz: Telefon jiringlayapti. Men olaman! Choymi yoki qahva? Choy olaman, iltimos.

scenes.title: Taxmin: will va going to
board: Opinion → will: I think it’ll be sunny.
Evidence now → going to: Look at those clouds! It’s going to rain.
probably / I’m sure / I don’t think + will
scenes.say: I think it'll be sunny tomorrow. Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
scenes.say_native: Uchinchi vazifa — taxmin, ya’ni kelajakda nima bo‘lishini oldindan aytish. Agar bu sizning fikringiz yoki ishonchingiz bo‘lsa, odatda “will” ishlatamiz va ko‘pincha “I think”, “probably”, “I’m sure” kabi so‘zlar qo‘shamiz: “I think it’ll be sunny tomorrow.”
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, ertaga quyoshli bo‘ladi. Anavi bulutlarga qarang! Yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

scenes.title: Taxmin misollari
scenes.say: You'll probably pass the exam. I don't think he'll come. Careful! You're going to fall!
scenes.say_native: Yana misollar. “You’ll probably pass the exam” — imtihondan o‘tsangiz kerak. “Probably” so‘zi “will” dan keyin, lekin “won’t” dan oldin keladi: “He probably won’t come.” Bundan tashqari, inkor taxminda inglizlar odatda “I don’t think he’ll come” deydi, ya’ni inkorni “think” ga qo‘yadi.
scenes.say_uz: Imtihondan o‘tsangiz kerak. Menimcha, u kelmaydi. Ehtiyot bo‘ling! Yiqilasiz!

scenes.title: Taklif va va’da: will
board: Offer: I’ll help you with that.
Promise: I’ll call you every day.
Shall I open the window? (Ochib qo‘yaymi?)
scenes.say: I'll help you with that. I promise I won't be late. Shall I open the window?
scenes.say_native: “Will” ning yana ikki muhim vazifasi bor: taklif va va’da. Taklif: kimgadir og‘ir sumka bilan qiynalayotganini ko‘rdingiz: “I’ll help you with that” — yordam beraman. Va’da: “I’ll call you every day” — har kuni qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. “I promise I won’t be late” — kechikmaslikka va’da beraman. Britaniya ingliz tilida taklifni savol shaklida berish uchun “Shall I…?”
scenes.say_uz: Bunga yordam beraman. Kechikmaslikka va’da beraman. Derazani ochib qo‘yaymi?

scenes.title: Shaklni adashtirmang
board: ✗ I bought tickets. I’ll visit Paris in May.
✓ I bought tickets. I’m going to visit Paris in May.
✗ The phone’s ringing. — I’m going to answer it.
✓ The phone’s ringing. — I’ll answer it.
scenes.say: I bought the tickets. I'm going to visit Paris in May. The phone's ringing. I'll answer it.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xil xato. Birinchisi: oldindan qilingan rejani “will” bilan aytish. Chiptalar olingan, demak bu aniq reja, shuning uchun “I’m going to visit Paris in May” deyiladi. “I’ll visit Paris” deyilsa, xuddi hozir o‘ylab topgandek eshitiladi. Ikkinchisi teskari xato: telefon jiringlaganda “I’m going to answer it” deyish.
scenes.say_uz: Chiptalarni oldim. May oyida Parijga bormoqchiman. Telefon jiringlayapti. Men javob beraman.

scenes.title: will yoki going to?
board: 1) A: The bag is heavy. B: I ___ help you.
2) We ___ move house. We found a flat.
3) Look at the sky! It ___ snow.
4) I think Uzbekistan ___ win the match.
scenes.say: Will or going to? Think about the reason.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta vaziyat. Har birida “will” yoki “going to” ni tanlang va sababini o‘ylang. Birinchi: sumka og‘ir, siz hozir yordam taklif qilyapsiz. Ikkinchi: biz uy ko‘chmoqchimiz, kvartira allaqachon topilgan. Uchinchi: osmonga qarang, qor yog‘adi, dalil ko‘rinib turibdi. To‘rtinchi: menimcha, O‘zbekiston o‘yinda g‘alaba qozonadi, bu shaxsiy fikr.
scenes.say_uz: will mi yoki going to? Sababini o‘ylang.

scenes.title: Javoblar va sabablar
scenes.say: I'll help you. We're going to move house. It's going to snow. I think Uzbekistan will win.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I’ll help you” — bu shu zahotdagi taklif. Ikkinchi: “We’re going to move house” — kvartira topilgan, reja tayyor. Uchinchi: “It’s going to snow” — osmondagi bulut dalil. To‘rtinchi: “I think Uzbekistan will win” — bu dalil emas, shaxsiy fikr, “I think” bilan “will” juda tabiiy. Agar to‘rttadan uchtasini to‘g‘ri topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi.
scenes.say_uz: Yordam beraman. Biz uy ko‘chmoqchimiz. Qor yog‘adi. Menimcha, O‘zbekiston g‘alaba qozonadi.

scenes.title: Kelishilgan uchrashuvlar
board: We’re flying to Istanbul on Friday.
scenes.say: I'm meeting Aziz at seven. We're flying to Istanbul on Friday. What are you doing tonight?
scenes.say_native: Qisqacha uchinchi shakl haqida. Agar reja boshqa odam bilan kelishilgan bo‘lsa, vaqt va joy aniq bo‘lsa, inglizlar ko‘pincha hozirgi davomli zamonni ishlatadi: “I’m meeting Aziz at seven” — soat yettida Aziz bilan uchrashaman. “We’re flying to Istanbul on Friday” — juma kuni Istanbulga uchamiz, chipta bor.
scenes.say_uz: Soat yettida Aziz bilan uchrashaman. Juma kuni Istanbulga uchamiz. Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsiz?

scenes.title: Kelajak vaqt iboralari
board: at the weekend (BrE) / on the weekend (AmE)
scenes.say: Tomorrow. Tonight. The day after tomorrow. Next week. Next year. At the weekend.
scenes.say_native: Endi kelajak vaqtini bildiruvchi iboralar. “Tomorrow” — ertaga, “tonight” — bugun kechasi, “this evening” — bugun kechqurun, “this afternoon” — bugun tushdan keyin. “The day after tomorrow” — indinga, bu o‘zbekchada bitta so‘z, inglizchada esa butun ibora. “Next week”, “next month”, “next year” — kelasi hafta, oy, yil.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga. Bugun kechasi. Indinga. Kelasi hafta. Kelasi yil. Dam olish kunlari.

scenes.title: Ko‘proq vaqt iboralari
board: in two days / in an hour (… dan keyin)
soon · later · one day (bir kun kelib)

examples.t: The film starts in an hour.
I'm going to call him tomorrow morning.

scenes.say: I'll be back in ten minutes. See you soon. One day I'm going to visit Japan.
scenes.say_native: Yana bir guruh ibora. “In” va vaqt miqdori kelajakda “…dan keyin” degan ma’noni beradi: “in two days” — ikki kundan keyin, “in an hour” — bir soatdan keyin, “in ten minutes” — o‘n daqiqadan keyin. “Soon” — tez orada, “later” — keyinroq, “one day” — bir kun kelib, orzular haqida gapirganda juda qulay: “One day I’m going to visit Japan.”
scenes.say_uz: O‘n daqiqadan keyin qaytaman. Tez orada ko‘rishamiz. Bir kun kelib Yaponiyaga boraman.

scenes.title: Predloglar: qachon kerak, qachon yo‘q
board: at 6 o’clock · on Monday · in July
scenes.say: at six o'clock, on Monday, in July. Next week, this Friday, tomorrow.
scenes.say_native: Vaqt predloglarini eslaylik. Aniq soatdan oldin “at”: “at six o’clock”. Hafta kunlari va sanalardan oldin “on”: “on Monday”, “on the fifth of May”. Oylar, fasllar va yillardan oldin “in”: “in July”, “in summer”, “in 2030”. Lekin “next”, “this”, “last”, “tomorrow”, “tonight” so‘zlaridan oldin hech qanday predlog qo‘yilmaydi. “Next week” deymiz, “in next week” emas.
scenes.say_uz: soat oltida, dushanba kuni, iyulda. Kelasi hafta, shu juma, ertaga.

scenes.title: Vaqt iboralaridagi xatolar
board: ✗ after two days (future) → ✓ in two days
✗ tomorrow in the morning → ✓ tomorrow morning
scenes.say: I'm leaving in two days. I'll call you after the lesson. See you tomorrow morning.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek o‘quvchilarining eng mashhur xatosi: “ikki kundan keyin” ni so‘zma-so‘z tarjima qilib “after two days” deyish. Kelajak haqida gapirganda, hozirdan boshlab hisoblansa, “in two days” deyiladi: “I’m leaving in two days.” “After” esa boshqa voqeadan keyin degan ma’noda ishlatiladi: “after the lesson”, “after lunch”. Yana: “in next week” emas, “next week”.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kundan keyin jo‘nab ketaman. Darsdan keyin qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ertaga ertalab ko‘rishamiz.

scenes.title: Vaqt iborasining o‘rni
board: I’m going to visit them next week. (end — odatiy)
Next week, I’m going to visit them. (start — urg‘u)
✗ I’m going next week to visit them.
scenes.say: I'm going to visit them next week. Next week, I'm going to visit them.
scenes.say_native: Vaqt iborasi gapning qayerida turadi? Ingliz tilida eng odatiy joy — gapning oxiri: “I’m going to visit them next week.” Agar vaqtga urg‘u bermoqchi bo‘lsangiz yoki bir nechta rejani tartiblab aytsangiz, boshiga qo‘yish mumkin: “Next week, I’m going to visit them.” Lekin uni fe’l va uning davomi orasiga qo‘yib bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say_uz: Kelasi hafta ularnikiga bormoqchiman. Kelasi hafta ularnikiga bormoqchiman.

scenes.title: Vaqtni to‘g‘ri ayting
scenes.say: Translate the time expressions and make a sentence.
scenes.say_native: Tarjima qiling va har biri bilan qisqa gap tuzing. Birinchi: ikki kundan keyin. Ikkinchi: kelasi yozda. Uchinchi: indinga. To‘rtinchi: shu shanba kuni ertalab. Predlog kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi, o‘ylab ko‘ring. Masalan, gapni “I’m going to…” bilan boshlang va oxiriga vaqt iborasini qo‘ying.
scenes.say_uz: Vaqt iboralarini tarjima qiling va gap tuzing.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say: I'm going to see my cousins in two days. We're going to travel next summer. I'm going to clean my room this Saturday morning.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: birinchi — “in two days”, “after” emas. Ikkinchi — “next summer”, oldida “in” yo‘q. Uchinchi — “the day after tomorrow”, “the” artiklini unutmang. To‘rtinchi — “this Saturday morning”, bu yerda ham predlog kerak emas. Namuna gaplar: “I’m going to see my cousins in two days.” “We’re going to travel next summer.”
scenes.say_uz: Ikki kundan keyin amakivachchalarimni ko‘rmoqchiman. Kelasi yozda sayohat qilmoqchimiz. Shu shanba ertalab xonamni tozalamoqchiman.

scenes.title: Rejalar haqida savollar: going to
board: Yes, I am. / No, I’m not.
What are you going to do?
Where / When / Who … are you going to …?
scenes.say: Are you going to travel this summer? Yes, I am. What are you going to do tonight? Where is she going to stay?
scenes.say_native: Endi savollar. “Going to” bilan savol tuzish uchun “am, is, are” ni egadan oldinga chiqaramiz: “You are going to travel” — “Are you going to travel?” Qisqa javob: “Yes, I am” yoki “No, I’m not.” Bu yerda “Yes, I’m” deb qisqartirib bo‘lmaydi, qisqa javobda to‘liq “I am” aytiladi. So‘roq so‘zli savollarda so‘roq so‘zi eng boshida turadi: “What are you going to do?”
scenes.say_uz: Bu yoz sayohat qilmoqchimisiz? Ha. Bugun kechqurun nima qilmoqchisiz? U qayerda qolmoqchi?

scenes.title: Savollar: will va -ing
board: Will you + verb? — Yes, I will. / No, I won’t.
What are you doing at the weekend?
scenes.say: Will you be at home tomorrow? Yes, I will. What are you doing at the weekend? Are you doing anything tonight?
scenes.say_native: “Will” bilan savol yanada oson: “will” ni boshiga qo‘yamiz. “Will you be at home tomorrow?” Qisqa javob: “Yes, I will” yoki “No, I won’t.” “Will you…?” savoli ko‘pincha iltimos ma’nosida ham ishlatiladi: “Will you help me?” Do‘stlar orasida rejani so‘rashning eng tabiiy usuli esa “-ing” shakli: “What are you doing at the weekend?”
scenes.say_uz: Ertaga uyda bo‘lasizmi? Ha. Dam olish kunlari nima qilyapsiz? Bugun kechqurun biror ishingiz bormi?

scenes.title: Savollardagi xatolar
board: ✗ What you are going to do?
✓ What are you going to do? / Are you going to travel? / Will you come?
scenes.say: What are you going to do? Are you going to travel? Will you come?
scenes.say_native: Savollardagi uchta odatiy xato. Birinchi: so‘z tartibini o‘zgartirmaslik: “What you are going to do?” O‘zbekchada savol faqat “-mi” yoki ohang bilan bo‘ladi, so‘z tartibi o‘zgarmaydi. Inglizchada esa “are” egadan oldinga chiqishi shart. Ikkinchi: “do” yordamchisini qo‘shish: “Do you going to travel?”
scenes.say_uz: Nima qilmoqchisiz? Sayohat qilmoqchimisiz? Kelasizmi?

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
board: 1) you / going to / visit your parents?
scenes.say: Make four questions and answer them.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savol tuzing. Birinchisi “going to” bilan ha-yo‘q savoli: ota-onangiznikiga bormoqchimisiz? Ikkinchisi so‘roq so‘zli: u nimani o‘qimoqchi? Uchinchisi “will” bilan: ertaga ishda bo‘lasizmi? To‘rtinchisi hozirgi davomli shakl bilan: bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsiz? Har bir savolga o‘zingiz uchun qisqa javob ham bering.
scenes.say_uz: To‘rtta savol tuzing va javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Are you going to visit your parents?
2) What is she going to study?
3) Will you be at work tomorrow?
scenes.say: Are you going to visit your parents? Yes, I am. Will you be at work tomorrow? No, I won't. What are you doing tonight? Nothing special.
scenes.say_native: Savollar: “Are you going to visit your parents?” — qisqa javob: “Yes, I am” yoki “No, I’m not.” “What is she going to study?” — “She’s going to study medicine”, masalan. “Will you be at work tomorrow?” — “Yes, I will” yoki “No, I won’t.” “What are you doing tonight?” — “I’m meeting some friends” yoki “Nothing special.”
scenes.say_uz: Ota-onangiznikiga bormoqchimisiz? Ha. Ertaga ishda bo‘lasizmi? Yo‘q. Bugun kechqurun nima qilyapsiz? Hech narsa.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: gonna va I’ll
board: to → weak [tə]: I’m going to [tə] eat
scenes.say: I'm going to call you. Fast: I'm gonna call you. I'll see you later. We'll be there.
scenes.say_native: Endi tabiiy talaffuz. Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar tez gapirganda “going to” ko‘pincha “gonna” bo‘lib eshitiladi: “I’m gonna call you.” Filmlar va qo‘shiqlarda buni doim eshitasiz. Uni tanib olishingiz kerak, lekin yozma ishda, ayniqsa imtihonda, faqat “going to” deb yozing. Yana bir narsa: “will” deyarli doim qisqa aytiladi: “I’ll”, “you’ll”, “we’ll”.
scenes.say_uz: Sizga qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Tez: I’m gonna call you. Keyinroq ko‘rishamiz. Biz o‘sha yerda bo‘lamiz.

scenes.title: Takrorlang
board: I’m going to stay at home.
What are you going to do?
scenes.say: I'm going to stay at home. I'll call you later. I won't be long. What are you going to do?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapni takrorlang. Avval aniq va sekinroq ayting, keyin tabiiy tezlikda. “I’ll” ni bitta bo‘g‘in qilib, “ail” deb ayting, “ay-vil” emas. “Won’t” da cho‘ziq “ou” tovushini saqlang. “Going to” dagi “to” ni urg‘usiz, yengil ayting. Gap davomida so‘zlar orasida to‘xtamang.
scenes.say_uz: Uyda qolmoqchiman. Keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ko‘p ushlanib qolmayman. Nima qilmoqchisiz?

scenes.title: Talaffuzni tekshiring
board: What are you [ˈwɒtəjə] going to do?
scenes.say: I'll call you later. I won't be long. What are you going to do?
scenes.say_native: O‘zingizni tekshiring. “I’ll call you later” gapida “I’ll” bitta bo‘g‘in bo‘lib eshitilishi kerak. “I won’t be long” — bu “ko‘p ushlanmayman, tez kelaman” degan juda foydali ibora, unda “won’t” aniq va cho‘ziq. “What are you going to do?” savolida “what are you” qo‘shilib, deyarli bitta so‘zdek eshitiladi.
scenes.say_uz: Keyinroq qo‘ng‘iroq qilaman. Ko‘p ushlanmayman. Nima qilmoqchisiz?

scenes.title: Tinglang: dam olish kunlari
scenes.say: Ben: Are you doing anything at the weekend, Kamola? Kamola: Yes, I'm going to visit my grandparents in Samarkand on Saturday. Ben: Nice! I'm playing football on Sunday morning. Kamola: But look at the forecast. It's going to rain on Sunday. Ben: Oh no. Then I'll stay at home and watch a film.
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Kamola va uning hamkasbi Ben juma kuni ishdan keyin dam olish kunlari haqida gaplashyapti. Tinglab bo‘lgach, uchta savolga javob berasiz: Kamola shanba kuni nima qilmoqchi? Ben yakshanba kuni nima qiladi? Ob-havo haqida nima deyishdi?
scenes.say_uz: Ben: Dam olish kunlari biror ishing bormi, Kamola? Kamola: Ha, shanba kuni Samarqandga buvim va bobomnikiga bormoqchiman. Ben: Zo‘r! Men yakshanba ertalab futbol o‘ynayman. Kamola: Lekin ob-havo ma’lumotiga qara. Yakshanba yomg‘ir yog‘adi. Ben: Voy. Unda uyda qolib film ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 1) What is Kamola going to do on Saturday?
2) What was Ben’s plan for Sunday?
3) What is the weather going to be like?
scenes.say: What is Kamola going to do on Saturday? What was Ben's plan? What will the weather be like? What does Ben decide?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Kamola shanba kuni nima qilmoqchi? Ikkinchi: Benning yakshanbadagi rejasi qanday edi? Uchinchi: ob-havo qanday bo‘ladi? To‘rtinchi: Ben oxirida nima qaror qildi? Javobni to‘liq gap bilan ayting va qaysi kelajak shakli ishlatilganini ham o‘ylang.
scenes.say_uz: Kamola shanba kuni nima qilmoqchi? Benning rejasi qanday edi? Ob-havo qanday bo‘ladi? Ben nima qaror qiladi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) He’ll stay at home and watch a film.
scenes.say: Kamola is going to visit her grandparents. Ben was going to play football. It's going to rain, so he'll stay at home.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Kamola shanba kuni Samarqandga buvisi va bobosinikiga bormoqchi, bu reja, shuning uchun “I’m going to visit”. Benning rejasi yakshanba ertalab futbol o‘ynash edi, u kelishilgan, shuning uchun “I’m playing”. Ob-havo ma’lumoti dalil, shuning uchun “It’s going to rain”. Va nihoyat, Ben shu zahotning o‘zida qaror qildi: “Then I’ll stay at home.”
scenes.say_uz: Kamola buvisi va bobosinikiga bormoqchi. Ben futbol o‘ynamoqchi edi. Yomg‘ir yog‘adi, shuning uchun u uyda qoladi.

scenes.title: Tinglang: kelasi yil rejalari
scenes.say: Teacher: So, Dilnoza, what are you going to do next year? Dilnoza: I'm going to study at university in Tashkent. Teacher: What are you going to study? Dilnoza: Computer science. But first I'm going to work in my uncle's shop in the summer. Teacher: Good idea. Will you live with your family? Dilnoza: No, I probably won't. I'll probably share a flat with friends. Teacher: I'm sure you'll do very well.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog jiddiyroq. O‘qituvchi bitiruvchi o‘quvchisi Dilnozadan kelasi yil rejalari haqida so‘rayapti. Tinglang va keyin to‘rtta savolga javob bering: Dilnoza qayerda o‘qimoqchi? Nimani o‘qimoqchi? Yozda nima qiladi? O‘qituvchi unga qanday taxmin aytdi? Dialogda “probably” va “I’m sure” so‘zlariga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say_uz: O‘qituvchi: Xo‘sh, Dilnoza, kelasi yil nima qilmoqchisan? Dilnoza: Toshkentda universitetda o‘qimoqchiman. O‘qituvchi: Nimani o‘qimoqchisan? Dilnoza: Kompyuter fanlarini. Lekin avval yozda amakimning do‘konida ishlamoqchiman. O‘qituvchi: Yaxshi fikr. Oilang bilan yashaysanmi? Dilnoza: Yo‘q, ehtimol yo‘q. Ehtimol, do‘stlarim bilan kvartira ijaraga olaman. O‘qituvchi: Ishonamanki, juda yaxshi o‘qiysan.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
board: 1) Where is Dilnoza going to study?
2) What is she going to study?
3) What is she going to do in the summer?
scenes.say: Where is she going to study? What will she study? What is she going to do in the summer? Where will she probably live?
scenes.say_native: Javob bering. Birinchi: Dilnoza qayerda o‘qimoqchi? Ikkinchi: u qaysi yo‘nalishni o‘qimoqchi? Uchinchi: yozda nima qilmoqchi? To‘rtinchi: u ehtimol qayerda yashaydi? Agar biror javobni eslay olmasangiz, dialogni yana bir marta tinglab ko‘ring.
scenes.say_uz: U qayerda o‘qimoqchi? Nimani o‘qiydi? Yozda nima qilmoqchi? Ehtimol qayerda yashaydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) She’ll probably share a flat with friends.
scenes.say: She's going to study computer science in Tashkent. She'll probably share a flat with friends.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Dilnoza Toshkentdagi universitetda o‘qimoqchi. U kompyuter fanlarini o‘qimoqchi. Yozda amakisining do‘konida ishlamoqchi. Ehtimol, do‘stlari bilan kvartirada yashaydi. E’tibor bering: aniq rejalar uchun u “going to” ishlatdi, aniq bo‘lmagan narsa uchun esa “probably” bilan “will” ni: “I’ll probably share a flat.”
scenes.say_uz: U Toshkentda kompyuter fanlarini o‘qimoqchi. Ehtimol, do‘stlari bilan kvartirada yashaydi.

scenes.title: Niyatni yumshoq aytish
board: I’d like to … / I hope to … (istayman / umid qilaman)
scenes.say: I'm planning to open a café. I'd like to learn Korean. I'm not sure. Maybe I'll go to the cinema.
scenes.say_native: Rejangiz hali aniq bo‘lmasa, buni ham aytishingiz kerak. Buning uchun bir nechta foydali ibora bor. “I’m planning to open a café” — kafe ochishni rejalashtiryapman. “I’d like to learn Korean” — koreys tilini o‘rganishni istardim. “I hope to get a scholarship” — grant olishga umid qilaman.
scenes.say_uz: Kafe ochishni rejalashtiryapman. Koreys tilini o‘rganmoqchiman. Bilmadim. Balki kinoga borarman.

scenes.title: Sizning rejalaringiz
board: Next weekend: I’m going to … / I’m meeting …
Next year: I’m planning to … / I’d like to …
scenes.say: Now tell me about your plans for next weekend and next year. Start!
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy mashq. Yarim daqiqadan ko‘proq vaqt davomida o‘z rejalaringiz haqida gapiring. Avval keyingi dam olish kunlari: kamida ikkita reja ayting, vaqt iboralari bilan. Keyin kelasi yil: nima qilmoqchisiz, nimani istaysiz. Oxirida bitta taxmin qo‘shing, masalan, “I think it will be a great year.” Ekrandagi namunalarga qarab, baland ovozda gapiring.
scenes.say_uz: Endi keyingi dam olish kunlari va kelasi yil rejalaringiz haqida gapiring. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: On Saturday I’m going to clean the flat.
On Sunday I’m meeting my friends.
Next year I’m planning to change my job.
I think it’ll be a busy year.
scenes.say: On Saturday I'm going to clean the flat. On Sunday I'm meeting my friends. Next year I'd like to go to Turkey. I think it'll be an exciting year.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna javob. “On Saturday morning I’m going to clean the flat, and in the afternoon I’m going to visit my parents. On Sunday I’m meeting my friends in the park. Next year I’m planning to change my job, and I’d like to go to Turkey in the summer. I think it’ll be a busy but exciting year.”
scenes.say_uz: Shanba kuni kvartirani tozalamoqchiman. Yakshanba do‘stlarim bilan uchrashaman. Kelasi yil Turkiyaga bormoqchiman. Menimcha, qiziqarli yil bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: will → decision now, offer, promise, opinion
-ing → arrangement · in two days · next week
Are you going to…? Will you…? What are you doing…?
scenes.say: Well done! Now you can talk about your plans, decisions and predictions.
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. “Going to” — oldindan o‘ylangan reja va ko‘z oldidagi dalilga asoslangan taxmin uchun. “Will” — shu zahotdagi qaror, taklif, va’da va shaxsiy fikr uchun. Hozirgi davomli shakl esa kelishilgan uchrashuvlar uchun. Vaqt iboralarini o‘rgandik: “next week” oldida predlog yo‘q, “ikki kundan keyin” esa “in two days”.
scenes.say_uz: Barakalla! Endi rejalaringiz, qarorlaringiz va taxminlaringiz haqida gapira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
scenes.say: See you next time. Have a great weekend!
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Keyingi dam olish kunlari va kelasi yil rejalaringizni yozing: har biri uchun kamida to‘rttadan gap. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida uchta gapda “going to”, kamida bitta gapda “will” bilan taxmin yoki va’da, kamida bitta kelishilgan uchrashuv “-ing” shaklida va kamida to‘rtta turli vaqt iborasi bo‘lsin. Keyin matnni ovoz chiqarib o‘qib, yozib oling.
scenes.say_uz: Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Dam olish kunlaringiz yaxshi o‘tsin!

homework_uz: Keyingi dam olish kunlari va kelasi yil uchun rejalaringizni yozing (har biriga kamida 4 ta gap), so‘ng ovoz chiqarib o‘qib yozib oling. Mezon: kamida 3 ta gapda going to, kamida 1 ta will bilan taxmin yoki va’da, kamida 1 ta kelishilgan uchrashuv -ing shaklida, kamida 4 ta turli vaqt iborasi (in next week va after two days kabi xatolarsiz).

quiz.q: You bought plane tickets last week. Which sentence is best?
options: I'll fly to Dubai in May.
I'm going to fly to Dubai in May.
I fly to Dubai in May, I think.
I will flying to Dubai in May.
quiz.why_uz: Chipta olingan — oldindan tuzilgan reja, shuning uchun going to.

quiz.q: The phone is ringing. What do you say?
quiz.why_uz: Shu zahotdagi qaror — will: I’ll answer it.

quiz.q: Look at those black clouds! It ___ rain.
quiz.why_uz: Ko‘z oldidagi dalil asosidagi taxmin — be going to.

options: She is going to studies medicine.
She is going to study medicine.
She is go to study medicine.
quiz.why_uz: am/is/are + going to + fe’lning lug‘at shakli.
Hozirdan boshlab kelajakdagi muddat — in two days. After two days — o‘zbekchadan tarjima xatosi.
next, this, tomorrow oldidan predlog qo‘yilmaydi.

options: What you are going to do?
What are you going to do?
What do you going to do?
quiz.why_uz: Savolda are egadan oldinga chiqadi: What are you going to do?

quiz.q: “Will you be at home tonight?” — Short answer:
quiz.why_uz: Qisqa javobda qisqartma ishlatilmaydi: Yes, I will.

options: I not think he will come.
quiz.why_uz: Inkor taxminda inglizlar odatda inkorni think ga qo‘yadi: I don’t think he’ll come.

options: I am not going to go / I will not go.
quiz.why_uz: won’t = will not; want — xohlamoq. Talaffuzi ham farq qiladi: [wəʊnt] va [wɒnt].
